items.observed: Current canonical controls already admit at most 100 targets. A crash can leave a committed prefix. The older proposal requires a durable command/target receipt owner; it is not a selected recovery contract.
items.whyNeedsDecision: This changes persisted history and retry semantics; a new table or overloading diagnostics without a selected retention/recovery contract would add unreviewed complexity.
